summary: Evaluate the source-method N=64 rational Faddeeva approximation and its branch labels.

capability: Evaluate the source-method N=64 rational Faddeeva approximation and its branch labels.
operation: evaluate the fixed N=64 Weideman dispersion function
dimensionless complex z to approximate w(z), Z(z) and method flags
discovery.model: homogeneous Maxwellian plasma dispersion special function
discovery.boundary: finite representable arguments outside numerical poles of the rational approximation

identity.relation: dimensionless complex z to approximate w(z), Z(z) and method flags
identity.direction: dimensionless complex z to approximate w(z), Z(z) and method flags
identity.definition: Z(z)=i sqrt(pi) w(z), with N=64 Weideman FFT coefficients and the source's pure-imaginary erfc and lower-half-plane reflection branches.
identity.model: homogeneous Maxwellian plasma dispersion special function
identity.coordinates: complex argument plane; array axes belong to the caller
identity.boundary: finite representable arguments outside numerical poles of the rational approximation
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: z
inputs.description: Values of the complex variable to evaluate. May be a scalar or a real or complex `array_like` of any shape; axis meaning is caller-defined and this operator does not interpret physical axes. Units: dimensionless (normalized phase velocity z = omega/(k*vt)). Validity constraint: elements must be finite (no `NaN`/`inf`); elements with zero real part use the exact erfc branch, and elements with nonzero real part and negative imaginary part use the conjugate-reflection branch.
inputs.constraints: Elements must be finite (no `NaN`/`inf`); elements with zero real part use the exact erfc branch, and elements with nonzero real part and negative imaginary part use the conjugate-reflection branch.

outputs.name: Z
outputs.description: Plasma dispersion function value Z(z)=1i*sqrt(pi)*w(z). Shape exactly matches `z` (a scalar input gives a 0-d array), complex-valued `ndarray` (complex128). Units: dimensionless. Validity constraint: numerically valid only when all `z` elements are finite and away from the expansion poles; real points with zero real part give purely imaginary results.
outputs.shape: same shape as z; scalar gives a zero-dimensional array
outputs.constraints: Numerically valid only when all `z` elements are finite and away from the expansion poles; real points with zero real part give purely imaginary results.

outputs.name: w
outputs.description: Faddeeva function w(z)=exp(-z^2)*erfc(-1i*z). Shape matches `z`; complex-valued `ndarray`. Units: dimensionless. Validity constraint: inputs with negative imaginary part and nonzero real part return the conjugated lower-half-plane value rather than the upper-half-plane analytic continuation.
outputs.shape: same shape as z; scalar gives a zero-dimensional array
outputs.constraints: Inputs with negative imaginary part and nonzero real part return the conjugated lower-half-plane value rather than the upper-half-plane analytic continuation.

outputs.name: method
outputs.description: Elementwise string label, `'erfc'` (real(z)==0) or `'rational'` (otherwise). Shape matches `z`; `object` array. Units: dimensionless (enumeration label). Validity constraint: must be one of these two strings.
outputs.shape: same shape as z; scalar gives a zero-dimensional array
outputs.constraints: Must be one of these two strings.

outputs.name: all_purely_imaginary
outputs.description: Boolean scalar; True means every `z` element satisfies real(z)==0, triggering the frozen source's early return. Units: dimensionless (boolean). Validity constraint: necessary and sufficient for `method` to be entirely `'erfc'`.
outputs.constraints: Necessary and sufficient for `method` to be entirely `'erfc'`.
